changelog: Fixes published channels stopping at the end of a program on TV apps: looking up the follow-up entry asked the channel manager for a folder without naming its channel, which threw. Channel entries also carry their media details now - container, streams, the lot - instead of only resolving them when playback starts, since a player that is told nothing about the media may refuse to start it.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
